app.name: AI Job Assistant
app.tagline: Organize resumes, manage jobs, and tailor applications

hero.title: Find jobs, build resumes, and track applications—all in one place
hero.subtitle: Search public jobs, then sign in to build resumes, check quality, and manage your progress.

features.findBody: Search public roles by keyword, city, country, and work mode. No account needed.
features.resumeBody: Create a resume and review quality after you sign in.
features.trackBody: Rewrite a resume for a job, save roles, and follow applications after you sign in.

dashboard.welcomeHint: Your applications, searches, and resumes in one place.
dashboard.emptyJobs: No saved or applied jobs yet.
dashboard.emptySearches: Searches will show up here after you look for jobs
dashboard.getStartedHint: Search for jobs, or create a resume.

workbench.readyStatus: Complete — ready to tailor to a job
workbench.emptyResumesHint: Create or upload a resume and it will show up here.

workbench.emptyAppliedHint: After you apply, recent progress and dates will show up here.
workbench.subtitle: Keep your resumes and job search moving.
workbench.startBody: Create or upload a resume first. After that you can find jobs and rewrite it against a posting.
workbench.errorBody: Nothing came back this time. This is usually a network problem or an expired session.
workbench.onboardBody: Walk through these three steps and your applications, searches, and resumes collect here.
workbench.step1Body: Start a new one in the builder, or upload a PDF you already have.
workbench.step2Body: Search openings and save the good ones — saved jobs show up in your jobs list.
workbench.step3Body: Mark a job applied, then rewrite your resume against that posting.

resumes.structureHint: Review the extracted text. Layout is not treated as new facts. After confirming, you can start tailoring.

resumeQuality.title: Resume Quality Score
resumeQuality.disclaimerNotProbability: This is a structure and content-completeness score for your resume -- not a hiring probability, and not a job-match score.
resumeQuality.disclaimerNoAiQuota: This score does not use any AI quota.
resumeQuality.noStrengths: No standout strengths yet -- see the suggestions below.
resumeQuality.noSuggestions: No specific suggestions -- this resume covers the rubric well.

strength.STRUCTURE_COMPLETE: Well-organized structure with all key sections
strength.EXPERIENCE_WELL_DESCRIBED: Experience and projects are clearly described
strength.QUANTIFIED_ACHIEVEMENTS: Achievements are backed by real numbers

suggestion.ADD_CONTACT_INFO: Add a way to reach you (email or phone) near the top
suggestion.ADD_EXPERIENCE_OR_PROJECTS_SECTION: Add an Experience or Projects section
suggestion.ADD_MORE_DESCRIPTIVE_DETAIL: Add more descriptive detail to your experience or project bullets
suggestion.QUANTIFY_ACHIEVEMENTS: Add real numbers or percentages to show the impact of your work
suggestion.EXPAND_SKILLS_LIST: List a few more of your actual skills
suggestion.SHORTEN_LONG_BULLETS: Shorten bullets or paragraphs that run too long
suggestion.USE_CONSISTENT_DATE_FORMAT: Use one consistent date format throughout

reason.TEXT_NOT_AVAILABLE: We could not read any text from this resume (this often happens with an image-only scan). Try re-uploading a text-based PDF or DOCX.

tailor.title: Tailor resume
tailor.reanalyzeHint: Re-analyzing rematches the current resume only. It does not re-parse the job description.
tailor.refreshProfileConfirm: Use this only if the job description was parsed incorrectly. It will re-parse the current job description and may change scores. Continue?
tailor.needSelection: Select at least one suggested change
tailor.needResumeJob: Select a resume and a job
tailor.filesAfterConfirm: No file is generated until you confirm.
tailor.unsavedEdits: You have unsaved edits. Save or cancel them before confirming.
tailor.quickOptimizeHelp: Automatically fix grammar, wording, and clarity, then generate the optimized resume.
tailor.deepEnhanceHelp: Review each experience against the target job, ask up to 5 key questions, and use only what you confirm to draft a reviewable enhanced version. No file is changed or generated until you confirm.

enhanced.generating: Optimizing your resume with the target job and the details you confirmed…
enhanced.noFilesYet: No file is generated yet. DOCX and PDF are created only after you review and confirm.
enhanced.noHighValue: The check is complete. No evidence-backed enhancement is clearly stronger than the original wording, so the resume is left unchanged.
enhanced.cannotInventHint: The system will not add related experience unless it is already on your resume or confirmed by you.
enhanced.chooseEntry: Choose the related project or experience
enhanced.canConfirm: Can be added from your answers
enhanced.noQuestions: There are no required questions. You can still generate enhancement suggestions.
enhanced.answersStaged: Answers are saved on this page for now. They are submitted only after you click “Generate deep enhancement suggestions”.
enhanced.answersSubmitted: Answers were submitted. Generating enhancement suggestions.
enhanced.answerFailed: This answer could not be saved. Your input was kept. Please fix it and retry.
enhanced.generateFailed: Could not generate enhancement suggestions. Your scan and answers were kept. Please retry.
enhanced.confirmFailed: Confirmation failed. Your selections and edits were kept.
enhanced.completed: The deep enhancement resume is ready. Your selected sections were written to the files. Unselected experiences stay as original.
enhanced.leaveWarning: You have answers or edits that are not saved on the server. They may be lost if you leave.
enhanced.usageSummary: Saved {{saved}} added details: {{used}} used in enhancements; {{unused}} did not produce a version clearly stronger than the original.
enhanced.userRejected: You marked this as not used
enhanced.reasonNoAdmitted: Did not produce a version clearly stronger than the original.
enhanced.reasonAlreadyPresent: This detail is already in the original text.
enhanced.reasonNotASkill: This is a project result, so it was not added to Skills.
enhanced.reasonNoSkillsSection: This resume has no Skills section, and a new section was not created.
enhanced.reasonNotRelevant: Not relevant enough to this job.
enhanced.reasonValidator: This added detail did not pass validation.
enhanced.reasonConfirmedNotUsed: Confirmed details were not used in the final enhancement.
enhanced.deleteConfirm: Delete this saved detail? This does not change the original resume or generated files.

tailor.grammarOnlyNotice: Only grammar or clarity issues were found. This resume does not contain enough outcome detail for a stronger rewrite.
tailor.incompleteRecognition: The PDF auto-recognition is incomplete. Confirm the content before tailoring.
tailor.fileUnavailable: This resume file is unavailable. Please upload it again.
tailor.keptOriginalSummary: Some bullets could not be rewritten without adding new facts, so the original wording was kept.
tailor.addEvidenceHelp: These questions help create stronger resume content. Only provide facts that are true. Saving an answer does not change the current resume score until the evidence is added to the resume and analyzed again.
tailor.unlinkedProject: Not linked to a specific project
tailor.waitingToAdd: Waiting to be added to resume
tailor.needEducationDetails: Enter at least one of school, degree, or dates.
tailor.scoreUnchanged: Current score will not change yet
tailor.deleteEvidenceConfirm: Delete this evidence? You can answer the related question again afterward.
tailor.evidenceConflict: You already saved evidence of using this skill. Delete the existing evidence before marking it as not used.
tailor.notUsedConfirm: Confirm that you do not have this experience? It will not be added to your resume or asked again. You can change this later in the Evidence Bank.
tailor.needContextActionResult: Enter at least one of Context, What did you do, or Result or impact.
tailor.needRealDetails: Enter a real experience. Do not answer with only yes, 是, or used.
